mapper.select: select ps.* from product_sku ps INNER JOIN product p ON ps.product_id = p.id where p.status=1 and ps.is_deleted=0 and p.is_deleted=0 order by sale_num desc limit 10
select * from product_sku where id=#{skuId} and is_deleted=0
select * from product_sku where product_id=#{productId} and is_deleted=0
